meals.name: Roast chicken legs with root veg
meals.dk: Kyllingelår i ovn med kartofler & gulerødder
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss potatoes, carrots and onion wedges with oil, salt and thyme in a roasting tin.
Lay the chicken legs on top, skin up, season well.
Roast 45 min until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

meals.name: Soft tacos
steps: Brown the meat with taco spices (cumin, paprika, garlic, chili) and a splash of water.
Chop the vegetables. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Everyone builds their own with dressing and cheese.

meals.name: Tray-roast chicken & potatoes
steps: Roast potato chunks and vegetables with oil, salt and pepper at 200°C for 15 min.
Add the seasoned chicken and roast 20–25 min to 75°C in the middle.
Rest 5 min, slice and serve with bearnaise or a skyr dip.
meals.tip: Roast an extra 250 g chicken for the chicken salad lunch.

meals.name: Salmon with roast potatoes & greens
steps: Roast potato halves with oil and salt at 210°C for 20 min.
Add salmon and greens to the tray, season and roast 10–12 min more.
Serve with skyr mixed with lemon, dill and salt.

meals.name: Skyr bowl with fruit & oats
steps: Spoon the skyr into a bowl.
Top with fruit, oats, cinnamon and honey.

meals.name: Egg & cheese toast
steps: Fry the egg. Toast the bread with the cheese on top until melted.
Egg on top, black pepper.

meals.name: Yoghurt with muesli
steps: Bowl, yoghurt, muesli, fruit.

meals.name: Crunchy chicken salad
steps: Slice cooked chicken.
Toss vegetables and apple with skyr, oil, mustard and salt.
Top with chicken, rye bread on the side.

meals.name: Pasta salad box
steps: Cook the pasta and cool it under cold water.
Mix with the protein, chopped vegetables and a skyr-mustard dressing.

meals.name: Sausage & vegetable soup
steps: Fry the sausage or bacon and leek in oil.
Add diced potatoes and carrots, tomatoes, fond and 8 dl water.
Simmer 25 min and season. Keeps 4 days.
